name: Whiskey Rhythm

band.style_feel: medium-fast straight-eighths rock shuffle-free groove, kick on 1 and 3, snare on 2 and 4
parts: Part A: intro/interlude - twin-guitar riff, light drums
Part B: verse - steady groove, chords G Em C D
Part C: chorus - full band, open crash hits
Part D: solo - same groove, louder
Part E: outro - riff and fade
band.tips: Tempo and key from Tunebat/SongBPM (studio version); play the riff 2 bars cleanly before the Trio+ starts learning and keep strumming steady.

memo: Thin Lizzy - Whiskey in the Jar: rhythm. Eric Bell style, edge-of-breakup crunch with a light boost, slapback echo.

name: Whiskey Lead
memo: Thin Lizzy - Whiskey in the Jar: lead. Tone Bender-ish sustain with tape-style echo for the twin-guitar riff.
